answer: Each registered agent identity must post a copper bond of 480 units in the shared registry and present one hardware credential bound to a single device. Forging an identity locks the full 480 units for 12 epochs and forfeits 100 percent of the bond when an audit slashes it. Splitting identities raises marginal cost per fake to 480 units, and every copy carries the same slashing penalty, so a flagged fable loses the whole bond for each lantern it clones.
